info.title: FlyBot public Bot integration API
info.description: Source-matched restricted backend gateway. Native endpoint dispatch and versioned application commands share POST /api/bot. Inspect x-flybot-operations for correlated response, current rights, prerequisites, state effects and recovery. This artifact documents existing behavior; it does not deploy a service or grant access.

origin.description: Actual operator-provided backend origin; prefer HTTPS for remote use. No URL token.

post.description: Callback on the explicitly verified receiver endpoint, not a new FlyBot inbound route. Verify HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + "." + exactRawBody), timestamp tolerance and persistent eventId deduplication. Then authenticate to FlyBot and claim the message; notification grants no permission.

schema.description: Opaque server-issued ID; never infer authority from it.

200.description: Metadata accepted only; connection.verify must echo the exact challenge and prove HMAC-SHA256(key, "challenge." + challenge). Not a processing/business acknowledgement.

challenge.description: Opaque server-issued ID; never infer authority from it.

post.x-delivery: at-least-once; use authenticated inbox as authority

200.description: Liveness only; not proof of provider readiness.

post.summary: Dispatch a native endpoint or a project-development/v1 query/command
post.description: Select a request branch by endpoint and, for v1, kind/name. x-flybot-operations correlates that request with its exact success/result schema. HTTP 200 includes domain failures; inspect ok before value. Security differs by dispatch; anonymous access is only for explicit discovery/login/redeem.

parameters.description: Same opaque cursor as after. If both are present they must match. Duplicate/unknown query keys are refused.

200.description: UTF-8 SSE. snapshot when no cursor, fact for committed events; comment keep-alive; reset-required/access-revoked then close. Reauthenticate and take a fresh snapshot as instructed, never replay commands.

agentWebhookSignature.name: X-Flybot-Signature
agentWebhookSignature.description: Computed HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + dot + exact raw body using the explicitly provisioned private notification key; verify timestamp and eventId replay protection. Never an FBA credential.

memberSession.name: X-Flybot-Member-Session
memberSession.description: Secret human session returned by platform-login/auth-redeem or private local bootstrap. No public self-signup or refresh endpoint.

personalAgentToken.name: X-Flybot-Member-Session
personalAgentToken.description: Independent fba_ token, issued once by the human for explicit Project scopes. The same header as memberSession; do not send both. Safe by default. Watch can only be granted/revoked by its human.

JsonValue.description: Opaque JSON source/provider data, not executable authority. Exact bytes use hash-bound source pages.

sessionToken.description: Secret returned once; use X-Flybot-Member-Session, never query strings.
